requirements.title: AI Generation & Editing Breadth
requirements.description: Outpaint/generative-expand and background replace added as first-class ops with standalone backends, hardware-aware selection, and full CLI/API parity. Both are masked-regenerate ops on the diffusers backend (seeded sd-1.5-inpainting / ic-light-v1), wired into the AI catalog + the generic submit edge + CLI (`ai outpaint`, `ai background-replace`). They gate honestly (HTTP 409) until the diffusers backend + weights are installed.

validation.notes: outpaint + background_replace registered in the AI catalog (generation, RequiresImage+RequiresMask+PromptDriven) and each gets a dispatcher runner.
outpaint + background_replace dispatch through the diffusers inpaint sidecar (image+mask+prompt argv); a missing mask errors.
CLI exposes `ai outpaint` + `ai background-replace` submit commands over the headless job edge.
